items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'I've got a friend of mine... to bring to you my friend and pal, Chooseys, Raymond Kaleland, you know.

ctx.x: So, I said 'Well, there you are, ladies and gentlemen. To give you an idea.' I said 'You haven't seen nothing yet.' I said, 'I've got a friend of mine who I'm going to introduce to you. And he's got a great laughter. I think he's even inflicted with it, you know. And if he'd only leave the bottles alone, see, but he has his favorite bottle, you see, somewhere on deposits.' And I said 'It's my pleasure now, ladies and gentlemen,
to bring to you my friend and pal, Chooseys, Raymond Kaleland, you know. And Raymond Kaleland would come out and do his night on the town dance, you see.

Now, the audience is very happy, see. It takes right away. And then the critics started coming in there. I think there was a few critics' secretaries was there. Lot of stars was in the audience, you know, like Nipsy Russell. He's from my home state, you see. And there they call the dancing chauffeur up there now.
